Fees.Token Swap Fees: The hook's tax on each swap in a launched token's pool, at the launch's buy or sell rate.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The platform's cut of the tax: half of it, capped at 1% of the trade, paid to the treasury.
Revenue.Unplaced Creator Fees To Treasury: The part of the creator's cut the launch's payee list left unplaced, swept to the treasury.
Revenue.Swap Fees To BSTONK Holders: The creator cut of BSTONK's own pool, paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor.
Revenue.Basket Dividends To BSTONK Holders: Paid by the hook to the BSTONK basket vault as a payee on launches.
Revenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The platform's cut of the tax: half of it, capped at 1% of the trade, paid to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Unplaced Creator Fees To Treasury: The part of the creator's cut the launch's payee list left unplaced, swept to the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To BSTONK Holders: The creator cut of BSTONK's own pool, paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor.
HoldersRevenue.Basket Dividends To BSTONK Holders: Paid by the hook to the BSTONK basket vault as a payee on launches.
HoldersRevenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators And Token Holders: The creator's cut after the treasury's sweep and BSTONK holders' share: creator wallets, the token's own holders, its burn and its liquidity wedge.

Fees.Redeem Fees: 0.35% of the gross private-transfer amount, derived from Teleport mints as minted * 0.35 / 99.65.
Fees.Unwrap Fees: feeAmount from LiquidityManager Unwrapped events; the rate rises as liquidity falls below target (zBNB is exempt).

Revenue.Redeem Fees: Redeem fee withheld by the protocol.
Revenue.Unwrap Fees: Unwrap fees added to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.

ProtocolRevenue.Redeem Fees: Redeem fee withheld by the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Unwrap Fees: Unwrap fees added to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.

Fees.Protocol fee on bet claim: Protocol fee taken from the pot when the winner claims (protocolFee on the Claimed event). The on-chain rate is 0 bps at launch, so this reads 0 until it is raised.
Fees.Judge fee on bet claim: Judge fee taken from the pot when the winner claims (arbiterFee on the Claimed event). Set per bet by the creator; 0 when the bet uses the house judge or names no fee.

Revenue.Protocol fee on bet claim: The protocol fee share, paid to the protocol fee collector.

SupplySideRevenue.Judge fee on bet claim: Judge fees paid to the human judges who resolve bets.

Fees.Option Exercise Fee: Settlement fee on each leg exercised via `OptionExercised`. Computed as `1 / sf_fee_divisor` of the collateral burned and transferred to `feeCollector_address`.
Fees.Option Close Fee: Matched-pair close fee on each leg unwound via `PositionClosed`. Same rate as the exercise fee (so this is not a cheaper substitute for `exercise`) and transferred to `feeCollector_address`.

Revenue.Option Exercise Fee: Exercise settlement fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.
Revenue.Option Close Fee: Matched-pair close fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.

ProtocolRevenue.Option Exercise Fee: Exercise settlement fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.
ProtocolRevenue.Option Close Fee: Matched-pair close fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.

Fees.Treasury inflow: Every stablecoin transfer into the copyfomo treasury. The service fee and the gas billed back to the trader arrive together in one transfer and cannot be split on-chain.
Fees.$COPY creator fees: 2.7% of the COIN leg of every swap of the COPY/COIN Uniswap v4 pool on Robinhood Chain (PoolManager Swap events of the pool), valued at the hourly COIN price on Dune. Rate from the hook's launch config: 1% hook fee with 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax.

UserFees.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: everything copyfomo users pay.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral rewards: USDC sent by the copyfomo referral payout wallet on Base to referrers (its top-ups from the treasury are internal and excluded), plus any stablecoin sent by the treasury back to identified copyfomo user wallets.
SupplySideRevenue.Bundler gas cost: Gas the copyfomo bundler wallets paid to the ERC-4337 EntryPoint for users' operations, priced with the daily WETH / WBNB price.
SupplySideRevenue.Solana fee payer cost: SOL spent by the copyfomo Solana fee payer, which signs every copyfomo Solana transaction: signature fees and the rent of the token accounts it creates, net of rent returned on close (its balance change in its own transactions, excluding its top-ups co-signed by the Solana treasury), priced with the daily SOL price.

HoldersRevenue.Buyback & burn: COIN and USDG sent by the copyfomo creator wallets in every transaction that swaps on the COPY/COIN pool, delivers $COPY to them and burns $COPY from them (Transfer to the zero address) in that same transaction, since 2026-09-11 when the buyback programme started. The three manual buys of 2026-09-11, burned the next day in one transaction (hash in the query helper), are listed explicitly.

Revenue.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: gross service fees before the supply-side deductions.
Revenue.$COPY creator fees: Same as the Fees component: creator fees have no supply-side share.
Revenue.Referral rewards: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Bundler gas cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Solana fee payer cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Buyback & burn: Same as the HoldersRevenue component, subtracted from Revenue.

Fees.Curve Trade Fees: Base fee, creator tax and anti-snipe tax on bonding-curve buys and sells, reconstructed from each event's quoteIn and the curve's own immutable bps settings.
Fees.Launch Fees: Flat fee per launch, re-read from each factory since it differs per chain.
Fees.Graduation Fees: 2% of the raise, charged once when a curve graduates into a Uniswap v4 pool.

Revenue.Curve Trade Fees: Protocol's share of the base curve fee plus half of the anti-snipe tax.
Revenue.Launch Fees: All launch fees; the factory forwards them to the platform address on launch.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Creator's share of the base curve fee, their full creator tax, and half of the anti-snipe tax on their token.

Fees.NFT AMM trade fees: ETH trade fees on buyRandomNFT / buySpecificNFT / sellNFT.
Fees.NFT loan fees: Upfront ETH borrow fees on NFT-backed loans.
Fees.Stonk Interns mint fees (ETH leg + $STON: Stonk Interns mint fees: the $20 ETH leg of every paid release (DormantReleased.ethPaid), the $STONKBROKER mint leg (STONKBROKER transfers from the collection to the protocol treasury), and the flat $1 ETH promotion fee on every intern pay-share raise (InternShareSet.ethPaid).
Fees.Stonk Interns activation fees in $STONKB: One-time / upgrade $STONKBROKER activation fees on Stonk Interns (InternActivationManager Activated / ActivationUpgraded feePaid).
Fees.Swap-desk Relay app fees (1%): 1% Relay app fee on the crypto swap desk, measured as Base USDC Transfer outflows from the fee wallet toward StockBooster.

Revenue.NFT AMM fees → ProtocolFeeSink: 30% of ETH AMM fees retained by ProtocolFeeSink.
Revenue.NFT loan fees → ProtocolFeeSink: 30% of ETH loan fees retained by ProtocolFeeSink.
Revenue.Stonk Interns mint fees → protocol treas: Stonk Interns protocol share: 75% of the $20 ETH mint leg, 100% of the $STONKBROKER mint leg, and the $1 pay-share promotion fee (the 25% payroll leg is supply side).
Revenue.Stonk Interns activation fees in $STONKB: Full $STONKBROKER intern activation fee (burned half + protocol half).

ProtocolRevenue.NFT AMM fees → ProtocolFeeSink: 30% of ETH AMM fees retained by ProtocolFeeSink.
ProtocolRevenue.NFT loan fees → ProtocolFeeSink: 30% of ETH loan fees retained by ProtocolFeeSink.
ProtocolRevenue.Stonk Interns mint fees → protocol treas: Stonk Interns protocol share: 75% of the $20 ETH mint leg, 100% of the $STONKBROKER mint leg, and the $1 pay-share promotion fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Stonk Interns activation fees → protocol: Half of Stonk Interns activation fees in $STONKBROKER → protocol treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Stonk Interns activation fees burned (50: Burned half of Stonk Interns activation fees in $STONKBROKER (deflationary).

SupplySideRevenue.NFT AMM fees → StockBooster dividends to: 70% of ETH AMM fees → StockBooster stock-token dividend drops to activated brokers.
SupplySideRevenue.NFT loan fees → StockBooster dividends t: 70% of ETH loan fees → StockBooster stock-token dividend drops to activated brokers.
SupplySideRevenue.Stonk Interns mint ETH → intern Clock In: 25% of the Stonk Interns mint ETH leg → the intern Clock In payroll wallet (funds the first intern Clock In rounds).
SupplySideRevenue.Swap-desk Relay app fees (1%): Relay swap-desk 1% app fee forwarded to StockBooster as a Clock In bonus top-up.

Fees.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

Revenue.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

Fees.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

Revenue.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Router fee taken from the output token of each swap.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Router fee taken from the output token of each swap.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees To vfat: Router fees sent to the vfat.io fee collector.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To vfat: Router fees sent to the vfat.io fee collector.

Fees.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades.

Revenue.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades, retained by TRDEFI.

Fees.Service Fees: Total fees settled when attestors successfully submit verification reports.

UserFees.Service Fees: Total fees paid by users for successfully completed verification reports.

Revenue.Service Fees To Primus: Verification fees allocated to Primus when reports are completed.

ProtocolRevenue.Service Fees To Primus: Verification fees allocated to Primus when reports are completed.

SupplySideRevenue.Service Fees To Attestors: Verification fees paid to attestor node operators when reports are completed.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The fee charged on every swap of a launched token, in the asset the pool is paired against.
Fees.Opening Tax: The higher fee charged on swaps in the first minutes after a launch.
Fees.Launch Fees: The fee paid to create a launch, in the chain's native currency.
Fees.Terminal And Bot Fees: The fee the Peddles Terminal and trade bot add to a swap, in the chain's native currency.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of each swap fee.
Revenue.Opening Tax To Protocol: The protocol's share of the opening fee.
Revenue.Terminal And Bot Fees To Protocol: All Terminal and trade bot fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of each swap fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Opening Tax To Protocol: The protocol's share of the opening fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Terminal And Bot Fees To Protocol: All Terminal and trade bot fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Creators: The share of each swap fee paid to the token's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Token Holders: The share of each swap fee paid to holders of the launched token.
SupplySideRevenue.Opening Tax To Creators: The share of the opening fee paid to the token's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Opening Tax To Liquidity: The share of the opening fee returned to the pool as liquidity.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: 1% of each buy and sell on a coin's bonding curve, read in USDC from the curve's Bought and Sold events.
Fees.Uniswap v4 Pool Swap Fees: 1% of each swap in a graduated coin's Uniswap v4 pool, taken by the Lockcurve hook and booked as 1% of the USDC side of the PoolManager's Swap event.
Fees.Launch Fees: The flat USDC fee a creator pays the treasury when launching a coin.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Treasury: 30% of bonding curve trading fees, sent to the treasury.
Revenue.Pool Swap Fees To Treasury: 30% of pool swap fees, sent to the treasury.
Revenue.Launch Fees To Treasury: Launch fees, sent in full to the treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Treasury: 30% of bonding curve trading fees, sent to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Pool Swap Fees To Treasury: 30% of pool swap fees, sent to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees To Treasury: Launch fees, sent in full to the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Creators: 70% of bonding curve trading fees, paid to the coin's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Pool Swap Fees To Creators: 70% of pool swap fees, paid to the coin's creator.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The fee traders paid on the pools the plugin runs in, at the rate the plugin set.
Fees.MEV Rewards: Arbitrage captured by the plugin when a swap moves the pool away from the wider market, closed out in the same transaction.

Revenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: The protocol's weight in the distributor's share config, applied to each capture.

ProtocolRevenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: The protocol's weight in the distributor's share config, applied to each capture.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: The swap fee, which the pool's liquidity providers and its AMM earn in full.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards To LPs: The rest of every capture, paid to the pool's beneficiaries.

Fees.Trading Fees: 1% platform fee on GDEX swaps (Solana: plus 0.1% on SOL withdrawals, 1% when bridging), received by the GDEX treasury: in SOL on Solana, and on EVM chains as the KyberSwap router fee paid to the treasury, mostly in the native coin.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
Fees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
Fees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
UserFees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
UserFees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
Revenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
Revenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
Revenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fee remaining after the protocol slice, earned by liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Creators And In: Creator and integrator shares of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Creators And Integr: Creator and integrator shares of the guard-taken trade fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees, Split Not Read: Guard-taken trade fee whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Creators And Integrators: Creator and integrator shares of the creator tax.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax, Split Not Read: Creator tax whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.

Fees.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from the fee legs every Swap event carries.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator leg, claimable only to the market's immutable creator. Launch presets: 0.70% of each trade on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets, 0.10% on factory 0.11.0 markets; actual amounts are read from each Swap event.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Curve Reserves: The depth leg, which stays in the market's curve reserve and raises its price floor.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Buyback And Burn: The buyback leg, spent only on buying and burning the market's own token.

Fees.Trading fees: Exact totalFee in FeesAccrued, denominated in that registered pool configuration quote asset. Native ETH and native Arc USDC are 18-decimal raw amounts; ERC-20 quotes retain their own decimals. USD totals depend on DefiLlama historical price coverage.

Revenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to creator recipients: Per-swap gross quote times immutable creatorBps, minus buyback allocation and referral allocation only when the event names a nonzero referrer.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to referrers: Per-swap gross quote times referralBps floored, only for an authenticated nonzero FeesAccrued referrer. Later claims are excluded.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to launched-token buybacks: Per-swap gross quote times buybackBps floored; later buybacks and burns settle this allocation and are not new fees or protocol-holder revenue.

Fees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

Revenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees To Partners: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.
